episode_title: Ep. 95 | Real Estate by Day, Event Mogul by Night

real_qa.q: What was Tino Vigil's first event and how many tickets did he sell?
real_qa.r: Tino Vigil's first event was a Valentine's Day singles party in February 2024 at BrewDog in Denver, where he sold 200 tickets at $10 each. The TikTok post about the event had 100,000 views. He set up decorations, hired a DJ (his cousin), served tacos and margaritas, had piñatas, and created a 'dump your ex wall' where attendees wrote about their exes on sticky notes.
real_qa.requete: Tino Vigil first event Valentine's Day Denver

real_qa.q: How many people attended Tino Vigil's Coors Field rooftop event on July 10th?
real_qa.r: Tino Vigil's first Coors Field rooftop event on July 10th drew 2,300 people, exceeding his initial expectations of 700 attendees. Ticket sales the day before totaled $1,200, but an additional $650 in tickets were sold day-of. The event cost $23,000 in total expenses including venue, DJs (Squizzy and DJ Sin), and security arrangements with Denver Police Department.
real_qa.requete: Tino Vigil Coors Field July 2300 people

real_qa.q: What was Tino Vigil's ticket price for his Coors Field rooftop events?
real_qa.r: Tino Vigil charged $30 per ticket for both his Coors Field rooftop events in July and September 2024. At $30 per ticket with 2,300 attendees at the first event, he generated $69,000 in ticket revenue, though after $23,000 in expenses he netted approximately $46,000.
real_qa.requete: Coors Field rooftop event ticket price 30 dollars

real_qa.q: How much did Tino Vigil spend on expenses for his first Coors Field rooftop event?
real_qa.r: Tino Vigil's total expenses for the first Coors Field rooftop event were $23,000, covering the venue rental, DJ fees for Squizzy and DJ Sin, security arrangements with Denver Police Department, and venue-provided insurance that he paid for.
real_qa.requete: Coors Field rooftop event 23000 expenses costs

real_qa.q: When did Tino Vigil start throwing events and what was his career background before that?
real_qa.r: Tino Vigil began throwing events in February 2024 after working 10 years in the Colorado Rockies clubhouse with players and also holding a real estate license for 7-8 years through his family business Vigil and Associates. He decided to pursue event organization full-time as real estate business had slowed down, posting TikTok videos for fun initially to stay busy when his five-year-old son was not with him.
real_qa.requete: Tino Vigil event business started February 2024 Colorado Rockies

guest.titre: Real Estate Agent and Event Organizer
guest.bio_context: Tino Vigil is a Denver native who has worked in the Colorado Rockies clubhouse for 10 years and holds a real estate license for 7-8 years through his family's agency, Vigil and Associates, founded by his grandmother approximately 40 years ago and now operated by his father Andy Vigil. He recently pivoted toward event organization after posting on TikTok in February 2024, starting with a Valentine's Day singles party that went viral with 100,000 views and drew 200 attendees. He is a father to a five-year-old son and has a golf handicap of 4-5.
